column1: # RVA_COMPGEN pins cl does not emit in their own TU. Gated by
# gruntz.audit.compgen_pins --gate: a pin NOT listed here is FATAL, because a
# dropped pin silently removes a compiler-generated body from the scored
# universe and surfaces only as the README's anonymous (unmatched) row.
# A row here is an EMISSION problem, never a matching one: the body is
# compiler-generated and byte-correct the moment cl emits it.
# cl 5.0 keeps ONE inline-expansion budget PER CALLING FUNCTION, shared across
# every inline expanded there. Sites that overrun it become real calls, and
# THOSE DECLINED SITES ARE WHAT EMIT THE COMDAT. So retail having both an
# out-of-line body and inline expansions needs no device at all - just `inline`
# in the header and callers that expand enough to overrun the budget.
# The budget is per CALLER, not per TU, and caller SIZE alone does nothing
# (2 sites in a caller padded 86 -> 3779 instructions still both inlined).
# Therefore a row below means OUR CALLERS INLINE LESS THAN RETAIL'S DID - a
# reconstruction gap in the callers, not a missing device. Fix the callers.

column3: No obj emits it. Retail's four callers (BuildStatusBarTabs, BuildGameMenu, BuildTabzDialog, LoadTabSprites) overrun their inline budget and leave some sites as calls; ours do not, so cl expands every site. Forcing emission by hand was measured: the COMDAT lands at 100.00 but nothing then emits ??0CStatusBarItem@@QAE@XZ, so 0x1005d0's pin dangles instead (claim count a wash) and BuildStatusBarTabs 71.58 -> 69.24, BuildGameMenu 72.33 -> 66.93. Fix the callers, not the pin.

Emitted by 11 objs, none of them cimagecomdats - and 0xd5d70 lies INSIDE that TU's own RVA band (0xd5c10 CState::DrawScreenTextImage .. 0xd5da0 CWapObj::IsReady), so the pin cannot move without breaking TU contiguity. ~CLoadable is a header inline; cimagecomdats' own functions never overrun their budget, so cl expands it there and emits nothing. Same class as the row above.
